# Security policy

OpenTake records browser-tab media and interaction metadata locally, so privacy and storage failures are treated as security issues.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Email `isaac.corley@proton.me` with a concise reproduction, affected version or commit, and potential impact. You should receive an acknowledgement within seven days.

Do not include real recordings, credentials, browsing history, or other sensitive data. A synthetic reproduction is preferred.

## Supported versions

OpenTake is pre-release. Security fixes target the latest commit on `main`; no older version is currently supported.
